chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Yūnus, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Māḍī عليه السلام, who said:
Those guilty of all major sins, if the hadd punishment is carried out upon them twice, are killed on the third time.

key_terms.الْحَدُّ: the prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.فِي الثَّالِثَةِ: on the third occurrence or offense
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice, meaning after two prior applications of the punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person who repeatedly commits a major sin after the hadd punishment has already been carried out?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning repeat offenders among those who commit major sins subject to hadd punishments. It indicates that after the hadd has been enforced twice, execution follows upon the third offense.
